title: Close the visual system
procedure: founder-approved custom procedure (plan.md, 2026-08-11): one combined refine+design+architecture artifact -> founder approval -> same-session build (tests then code) -> one fresh review round. No separate refine/design/architecture/critique phases, no second human gate.

sessions.result: clean: base fresh, no dependencies, rules present, bootstrapped

approvals.decision: APPROVED — recommended scope split (S4.1): radii, inputs, status close fully; buttons close partly (63 sites); remainder enumerated. No size cuts (all five axes, full enforcement). Icon buttons: one size="icon", painted proof required. E5 recess rule: OUT, left to AZ15. Confirmed assumptions: delete Button variant="amber"; rounded-[var(--r-pill)] is the one spelling of pill.

notes: Plan's radius finding is wrong: 3.35544e+07px is Tailwind v4 rounded-full (calc(infinity * 1px)), not an off-scale value. Real off-scale radii: 21. The genuine defect is the two spellings of pill.

Source measurement is worse than the plan's rendered-DOM measurement: 118 button recipes (not 47), 25 input recipes over a surviving DaisyUI control system, 79 uses of --surface-container in 27 shapes. Status is better: StatusChip forked in only 5 named places.

Root cause of non-enforcement: `npm run lint` runs `eslint . --quiet`, which does not run warn-level rules at all; every core-ui design rule is at warn; three plugin rules are registered nowhere; `npm run lint:design` crashes on main.
